title: Orientation preference switch (Straight / Queer / All)
notes: Members set an orientation preference in Settings (Discovery Preferences) and on their public profile, defaulting to All

Everything is filtered by preference while staying legacy-safe: matches, directory (listings/venues/services), ads, content feed, events, gigs, products, experiences, forum subforums and threads; unmarked items are always visible
All 8 provider content forms (event, gig, listing, venue, content, service, product, experience) and the provider subforum form gained an audience field; fresh and edited records persist orientation
Orientation chips label member-facing cards; threads inherit their subforum's orientation
